14729|9e055276.name: Ralston Farnsley
14729|9e055276.text:
You there... it is in your best interest to aid the Forsaken during these dire times.  Listen closely, as I dislike repeating myself.

We currently find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  Bandages and simple textiles are running low, and donations are being accepted to bolster sagging inventories.  While you'll not receive financial compensation - hence what donation means - your aid will not go unnoticed.

2132|db927cdf.name: Carolai Anise
2132|db927cdf.text: Nice to see a friendly face. I don't get much chitchat from Apothecary Johaan unless he wants something. He's been out of the grave too long. Someday I'll be like that, I hear. Creepy. Maybe by then I won't care.

246349|da04ef25.name: Breton Samuels
246349|da04ef25.text:
If you've come seeking the fellowship of your fellow paladins, you've come to the right place. 

Welcome home.

246389|8e0ab317.name: Hilda the Breaker
246389|8e0ab317.text:
Why do they call me "The Breaker"?

Trust me, you don't want to know.

246389|b676ae27.name: Hilda the Breaker
246389|b676ae27.text:
A little bit of a lot of things. Mostly I take the soft and weak and reshape them into hardened fighters once again.

It's a tough world out there, and even our own people mistrust us. We need to be tough and self-reliant if we are to fit into this "horde" with the rest of our people.

246393|a5383807.name: Jorin Croge
246393|a5383807.text: There are many things lurking out there in the dark and the light is needed now more than ever. If only these poor souls could see that just because our world has changed, that doesn't mean we have to be the monsters that the living think we are.

246393|af07d724.name: Jorin Croge
246393|af07d724.text:
I make sure we are provisioned and that the scant resources we do are distributed properly. 

If this were a proper order, I'd be something of a quartermaster. Such as we are however, I just do my best to make sure we are at least somewhat equipped to deal with the dangers all around us.

246394|63539e70.name: Ander Solliden
246394|63539e70.text: In my previous life, I lived nearby here. I still wander the fields of my childhood farmstead occasionally. It fills me with sadness to see those I knew and loved, shambling around as mindless thralls. It pains me, but its that very pain that gives me strength and purpose.

246394|82d61c10.name: Ander Solliden
246394|82d61c10.text:
Mostly the usual. Murloc attacks, the occasional Scarlet Crusade skirmish. There are even some paladins that can't quite adjust to life as a Forsaken. Far too often we have to put those down that turn their blades upon their brothers. 

By far the worst is when some mindless thrall wanders too close. I can kill murlocs all day, but some of the scourge I've had to destroy were former friends of mine. Some were even family members.

I'd rather it be me who puts them down than some random adventurer, but it still stings.

267008|b4ea9d59.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
267008|b4ea9d59.text: They named it Bandarion Keep. I wonder what Garek would make of that?

272526|bf500b92.name: Glix Xizzix
272526|bf500b92.text:
Yes, I am the renowned trader who magnanimously fed the uh, starving... children...? ...of the Undercity during the recent war with the Scourge. Yes, I am the visionary businessgob and logistical genius who single-handedly armed the resistance and allowed our Dark Lady to found her nation of smelly corpses... um, I mean, "Forsaken."

Yep, I'm him. Glix Xizzix. I'd be happy to sign an autograph. For a small fee, of course.

What am I doing here running a barbershop, you ask? Well I got one word for you, bub--diversification. You've got to keep your revenue streams diversified!

4596|60f0c131.name: James Van Brunt
4596|60f0c131.text: You waste my time, go talk with my student Basil.

4605|3a5f002e.name: Basil Frye
4605|3a5f002e.text: You are not trying to kill the anvil with your hammer, you are trying to create a weapon to kill your foes with. Let me show you what you are doing wrong.

4731|52a47c36.name: Zachariah Post
4731|52a47c36.text:
I have little time to sit and have idle banter with you. If you desire one of my steeds, seek Velma over there and she will teach you how to ride a skeletal steed.

I would not have you harming one of my beautiful horses with your ignorance.

4773|0450da3d.name: Velma Warnam
4773|0450da3d.text: I can teach you the finer points of Skeletal Horse Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!

5688|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Renee
5688|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

5690|c2467ddc.name: Clyde Kellen
5690|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

5819|9831b834.name: Mirelle Tremayne
5819|9831b834.text:
If you're looking for plate armor, mail armor or shields, I've got the finest in all of Undercity. Most of these pieces made and repaired here locally, though some is scavenged.

Feel free to browse.

356-complete.name: Deathguard Linnea
356-complete.text: Very good. Your efforts do much to keep the Scourge at bay. A commendation will be sent to my superior, Executor Zygand.
356-complete.title: Rear Guard Patrol

366-complete.name: Gunther Arcanus
366-complete.text:
My book?!?  So you were the thief who stole it!

But...what is this new enchantment upon it...Bethor?  He is in  Lordaeron?

If he still exists, then perhaps he too escaped from the Lich King's grasp...
366-complete.title: Return the Book

366-progress.name: Gunther Arcanus
366-progress.text: Your masters are fools to send you here, for I will never again be a Scourge slave!
366-progress.title: Return the Book

369-complete.name: Apothecary Johaan
369-complete.text: Ah, this venom will do perfectly, $N.  Everything else has been added to my concoction and boiled down.  Finally, I am ready to try this new deadly agent!
369-complete.title: A New Plague

369-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
369-progress.text: Do you have some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider yet, $N?  It's the final component I need in order to test my experiment.
369-progress.title: A New Plague

371-complete.name: Executor Zygand
371-complete.text: Captain Vachon's death will slow down the Scarlet Crusade's advancement in Tirisfal quite a bit.  But other threats loom.
371-complete.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

372-accept.name: Executor Zygand
372-accept.text:
Scarlet Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in northern Tirisfal, past Faol's Rest.  According to the information we have, a ruthless commander named Captain Melrache is in charge of this evil crew.

I am entrusting you now with a special and dangerous mission.  Slay Melrache and his two bodyguards, in the name of The Dark Lady.
372-accept.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

408-complete.name: Magistrate Sevren
408-complete.text:
Your actions struck a telling blow against the Scourge.  And your victory will not go unnoticed - not by the Forsaken, nor by our enemies.

Continue the struggle as we all do, $N, and one day we will drive the Lich King himself from Azeroth!
408-complete.title: The Family Crypt

408-progress.name: Magistrate Sevren
408-progress.text: Time is not a luxury we have, $N.  With each passing hour, the Scourge's hold on Tirisfal Glades grows more firm.
408-progress.title: The Family Crypt

409-accept.name: Gunther Arcanus
409-accept.text:
You say you are not bound by the will of the Lich King, and the enchantment Bethor placed upon my book corroborates this.  But before I believe you I must have proof that you are enemy to the Scourge.

There is an old, bloody altar just off the southern coast of this island.  it is used by a powerful Scourge agent, Lillith Nefara.

Take a Candle of Beckoning from this crate here.  Light it on the altar and Lillith will awake.  Destroy Lillith, and I will believe you are the Lich King's foe.
409-accept.title: Proving Allegiance

409-complete.name: Gunther Arcanus
409-complete.text:
You have defeated Lillith Nefara, proving you are an enemy of the Scourge.  Incredible.

I had believed I was the only $R with free will, but you have shown me there are others who have broken the Lich King's domination.
409-complete.title: Proving Allegiance

410-complete.name: Unknown
410-complete.text: You place the Candle of Beckoning upon the table and light it...
410-complete.title: The Dormant Shade

410-progress.name: Unknown
410-progress.text: This is an old, beaten, bloody table.
410-progress.title: The Dormant Shade

411-accept.name: Gunther Arcanus
411-accept.text: Take this Nether Gem to my old comrade Bethor.  It will let us communicate ... and I have much to tell him.
411-accept.title: The Prodigal Lich Returns

411-complete.name: Bethor Iceshard
411-complete.text: You convinced him to join us!  You have done a great deed for the Forsaken, $N.  The Dark Lady will be informed.
411-complete.title: The Prodigal Lich Returns

411-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
411-progress.text: Have you returned Gunther's book?  Has he responded?
411-progress.title: The Prodigal Lich Returns

431-complete.name: Unknown
431-complete.text: You grab one of the candles and place it in your pack.
431-complete.title: Candles of Beckoning

492-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
492-accept.text:
According to the Deathguard, another one of those foolish Dwarven Mountaineers has just been captured.  The Deathguard likes to use the cellar of the Gallows End Tavern as a holding cell until prisoners can be "properly" dealt with.

Why don't you go see how the Captured Mountaineer enjoys this special drink I made for him?  It contains a subtle hint of what The Dark Lady has planned for the rest of Azeroth.
492-accept.title: A New Plague

492-complete.name: Captured Mountaineer
492-complete.text: Ah, a drink at last.  I'm sure it's no Rhapsody Malt but I'll take anything to whet the old whistle at this point.
492-complete.title: A New Plague

492-progress.name: Captured Mountaineer
492-progress.text: Why if I had my trusted rifle you'd be as good as dead, $C.  Just wait until the Steam Tank Brigade arrives to rescue me!
492-progress.title: A New Plague

7813-progress.name: Ralston Farnsley
7813-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Undercity for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7813-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

91282-complete.name: Breton Samuels
91282-complete.text: Another fresh recruit? Welcome to Tyr's Watch, brother.
91282-complete.title: A Second Home

91285-complete.name: Breton Samuels
91285-complete.text: We appreciate the assistance. I'm sure this won't stop the attacks entirely, but it'll hopefully slow them down a bit. It's hard enough rebuilding this place without a murloc trying to stab you in the back with a spear.
91285-complete.title: Murlocs at the Gates

91294-complete.name: Danitha Morr
91294-complete.text:
Breton sent you up here, eh? Excellent.

My name is Danitha Morr, and I am the closest thing this keep has to a commander. If you come seeking fellowship amongst those that still remain loyal to the light, you've come to the right place.

There's a lot of work to do here before we can fully establish ourselves, and we'd be most appreciative if you would be willing to lend aid.
91294-complete.title: Touring the Grounds

91316-complete.name: Jorin Croge
91316-complete.text: I'm glad to see that your trip to Shadowvale bore fruit. I'll send Breton and a few of the other new recruits over later to clear the rest of the cellar out and retrieve anything left down in the dark.
91316-complete.title: Making Repairs

91316-progress.name: Jorin Croge
91316-progress.text: They say location is everything. While this fortress may look imposing perched upon these bluffs, its turning out to be quite the challenge to stay supplied this far from proper civilization. An unfortunate oversight on our part.
91316-progress.title: Making Repairs

91317-complete.name: Danitha Morr
91317-complete.text:
Excellent work, $N. Every time one of these Tarnished strike out and kill one of the Forsaken, it becomes that much easier for our detractors to stoke mistrust towards us paladins. Eliminating them will help further our cause and solidify our place here in Tirisfal.

I suspect it may take a long time for us to be fully embraced by the Forsaken and the horde. It could take years... or maybe even decades, but the best we can do is keep trying to prove ourselves.
91317-complete.title: The Tarnished

91317-progress.name: Danitha Morr
91317-progress.text: The Tarnished threaten what little goodwill we have with the other Forsaken. As much as it pains me to cross blades with our former brothers and sisters, they must be stopped if our fledgling order is to survive.
91317-progress.title: The Tarnished

94427-complete.name: Tanis Alderwood
94427-complete.text: You... you are a $c? Please, do not hurt me. I-I know I'm not supposed to be panhandling. I have no quarrel with you or your order. Leave me be, I beg you!
94427-complete.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94434-accept.name: Tanis Alderwood
94434-accept.text:
Wait, you want to... help? Why would a $c want to help a beggar like me?

Well, I suppose that you could be of some assistance. 

Its my wife you see. She, well... she's falling apart. I mean that literally. The apothecaries can stitch her back together right as rain, but they are about the Dark Lady's business and none are available to help. If you could perhaps bring me some fresh cloth then I could at least make her a wrapping to hold her together while we wait for the apothecaries.
94434-accept.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94434-complete.name: Tanis Alderwood
94434-complete.text: This is very kind of you, $c. Very kind indeed.
94434-complete.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94434-progress.name: Tanis Alderwood
94434-progress.text: I hope that this is no imposition upon you, goodly $c.
94434-progress.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94435-accept.name: Tanis Alderwood
94435-accept.text: I don't know why you'd go out of your way to help me, but I appreciate it. If someone sent you my way, tell them I appreciate them too. You'll always have a friend in Tanis Alderwood, $c.
94435-accept.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94435-complete.name: Danitha Morr
94435-complete.text:
You have done well, $N. It was a small thing, but even small acts of service such as this may help strengthen our connection to the light.

The Dark Lady and many in her service mistrust us. Some even conspire against us, but we will visit their skepticism and fear with courage and righteousness. We will show them that we are members of the Forsaken and we are willing to do our part, be it large or small, to help our people prosper once again.

Take this symbol, you will need it for what comes next.
94435-complete.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94436-accept.name: Danitha Morr
94436-accept.text:
It's time to demonstrate your ability to channel one of the light's greatest gifts.

The item I just gave you is called the Symbol of Life. Take care, as it may cause you some discomfort to handle a talisman of the light such as this. The light may be anathema to the force that created us, but it is still our guide and ally. The pain reminds us of this.

Go see Deathguard Billmuth downstairs. He just arrived and he has petitioned us for aid. Show him and the Forsaken what a true $c can do.
94436-accept.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94436-complete.name: Deathguard Billmuth
94436-complete.text:
So you'll help me, then? Good, good. I'll admit I'm not proud of resorting to... well, resorting to asking paladins for aid. The priests waved me away and you might be my friend's only chance.

Please, help me.
94436-complete.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94438-accept.name: Deathguard Billmuth
94438-accept.text:
Falgan and I were sent on a mission to scout out scarlet activity in Venomweb Vale. We managed to sneak close enough to one of their camps to hear about new orders involving an attack on Brill. Before we could decide what to do next, I stepped on a twig and the noise alerted them to us.

Falgan yelled at me to run, so I ran. By the time I realized he wasn't with me, I was halfway to Brill. That brave idiot probably stayed behind to hold them off for me.

Please, find my friend and help him if you can.
94438-accept.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94438-complete.name: Deathguard Falgan
94438-complete.text:
I'm... back? And saved by a $c no less? I see you carry a Symbol of Life. I've not seen one of those since... well, since before the war when Lordaeron was a very different place. I can only assume you are here to help. Billmuth and I were sent here to scout out the scarlet activity here, and we found out that they are planning some kind of attack.

If you would be willing to help more, there may yet be more that you can do to help the Forsaken.
94438-complete.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94440-accept.name: Deathguard Falgan
94440-accept.text:
These Scarlet Crusaders often carry satchels with their deployment orders. We know an attack is coming, but if we can recover their orders, we can warn the rest of the Deathguard and prepare an ambush. 

You are clearly an impressive $c. Kill these scarlet animals and retrieve a copy of their orders and bring them back to Deathguard Billmuth. He'll take it from there.
94440-accept.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94440-complete.name: Deathguard Billmuth
94440-complete.text:
Thank you for saving my friend, $N. I will take these plans back to my commander and we will give those crusaders a welcoming they won't forget.

I know that many among our people mistrust you paladins, but it's clear to me that you are Forsaken through and through. I won't forget this, and I'll make sure others know of what you did here today.
94440-complete.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94441-accept.name: Deathguard Billmuth
94441-accept.text:
Please give my thanks to Danitha Morr and tell her that the rest of the Deathguard will hear about the service that the paladins of Tyr's Watch performed for us. 

You have a lot of promise as a $c, and I am proud to have those like you among the ranks of the Forsaken. Dark Lady watch over you, $N.
94441-accept.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94441-complete.name: Danitha Morr
94441-complete.text:
The Symbol of Life is only able to be used by a $c who is ready to make use of one of the light's greatest blessings. I'm proud to count you among us, and I now bestow upon you the gift of redemption. With this you will be able to resurrect your fallen companions. Use this new boon wisely.

You have done well for both the Forsaken as well as the paladins of Tyr's Watch. Any steps we can take to win the hearts and minds of our fellow Forsaken is well worth the effort. Go with the light, $N.
94441-complete.title: A Lesson in Divinity

95314-complete.name: Carolai Anise
95314-complete.text:
You say there is evil in Shadowvale? I admit, I am not surprised. The forest folk were an odd lot, and they did not care for visitors. Some believe the Whispering Forest itself is cursed, and the elixir distilled from its roots carries that same curse...

...but enough of superstition and rumors, $N. Thank you for the elixirs. Here, take this as payment.
95314-complete.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir

95314-progress.name: Carolai Anise
95314-progress.text: I trust you did not get lost?
95314-progress.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir

95328-accept.name: Unknown
95328-accept.text: Against your better judgement you scrape up and collect the squirming remains of the beast. Someone in Undercity might have a use for them.
95328-accept.title: Whispering Horror Residue

95328-complete.name: Father Lankester
95328-complete.text:
What an interesting specimen. From underneath the Whispering Forest, you say? It's no secret that foul place is touched by the void.

I welcome the opportunity to explore the mysteries of shadow, $c. Allow me to offer you payment for what you've found.
95328-complete.title: Whispering Horror Residue

95328-progress.name: Father Lankester
95328-progress.text: Do you have something for me, $c?
95328-progress.title: Whispering Horror Residue

95803-complete.name: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner
95803-complete.text:
I don't doubt Danitha's sincerity and desire to earn a place for your kind amongst the Forsaken. However, I suspect that this isn't the last time we'll see one of your brothers and sisters go mad and turn the light against their own people.

There may come a time when I decide that tolerating your misbegotten order is no longer in the best interests of the Forsaken. I suggest you continue to serve your people diligently.

We will be watching.
95803-complete.title: A Token of Good Faith

96897-complete.name: Hadric Harlson
96897-complete.text: Thank you for your aid, $c. If we do not wish to see Lordaeron's history repeat itself, we've got to be vigilant when threats like this spring up.
96897-complete.title: The Cult of the Damned

96898-complete.name: Hadric Harlson
96898-complete.text: Thank you. This should slow the efforts of the scourge in this area. I suspect the denizens of Tirisfal will be pulling these crystals out of the ground for years, but removing the most conspicuous of them can only help.
96898-complete.title: Remnants of War

96898-progress.name: Hadric Harlson
96898-progress.text: I'd advise you not come into too much physical contact with those crystals. Even shattered and spent, the lingering magic in these necrotic crystals is highly dangerous.
96898-progress.title: Remnants of War

98545-progress.name: Glix Xizzix
98545-progress.text: What's that? You say that Leonid sent you? Oh boy, haven't seen that crusty old soldier since Naxxramas was raining hell down on our heads.
98545-progress.title: Leonid's Letter

99142-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
99142-progress.text: More interruptions! Wait, it's you. Were you able to recover the tomb weed?
99142-progress.title: Tomb Weed

99152-complete.name: Hilda the Breaker
99152-complete.text:
Well done, recruit. We might just make something out of you yet.

With these bones we may be able to better understand how such a threat was able to go unnoticed for so long.
99152-complete.title: As Above, So Below

99152-progress.name: Hilda the Breaker
99152-progress.text: You'd best not be returning empty-handed. I either need the bones I asked for, or your body on a stretcher to confirm you at least gave it your all trying to get them.
99152-progress.title: As Above, So Below

99153-progress.name: Ephram Barbaro
99153-progress.text: Did you find the damned thing?
99153-progress.title: The One That Got Away
